rungs.title: Accounts Assistant
rungs.summary: Learning bookkeeping, the ledgers and the month-end routine.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the chart of accounts, invoicing and expense rules.
rungs.delivery: Processes invoices, payments and reconciliations accurately, with checks.
rungs.leadership: Meets deadlines, asks when unsure and keeps clean records.

rungs.title: Accountant
rungs.summary: Owns a set of ledgers and the month-end for them.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in double entry, VAT, payments, billing systems and reconciliation.
rungs.delivery: Closes the month for their ledgers on time and explains the variances.
rungs.leadership: Works with budget holders and sales on billing questions without friction.

rungs.title: Senior Accountant
rungs.summary: Owns reporting, controls and the accuracy of the books.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in tax, controls and management reporting; spots what looks wrong.
rungs.delivery: Owns the monthly and annual reporting and the controls behind it.
rungs.leadership: Reviews and mentors; presents numbers to non-finance managers.

rungs.title: Finance Manager
rungs.summary: Runs the finance function: budgets, forecasts and cash.
rungs.knowledge: Connects the numbers to the business model, cash and risk.
rungs.delivery: Owns budgets, forecasts, cash and the audit.
rungs.leadership: Manages the finance team and is a trusted advisor to department heads.

rungs.title: Head of Finance
rungs.summary: Owns finance strategy, compliance and investor trust.
rungs.knowledge: Sees financial, regulatory and operational risk together.
rungs.delivery: Owns financial strategy, funding, tax and audit outcomes.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders and advises the CEO and the board.
